gold.taskDescription: Prepare a complete 72-hour emergency food supply stocked and ready for use.

questions.title: How many people does this supply need to feed?
questions.description: Understanding the number of people determines total quantities needed.

questions.title: Do any household members have dietary restrictions or allergies?
questions.description: Knowing restrictions ensures all food choices are safe and appropriate.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit for this supply?
questions.description: A budget constraint shapes which food items and quantities are realistic.

questions.title: Where do you plan to store this emergency supply?
questions.description: Storage location affects what packaging, containers, and food types are suitable.

questions.title: Will you have access to cooking equipment or just eat ready-to-eat foods?
questions.description: Cooking capability determines whether raw or prepared shelf-stable foods are practical.

questions.title: Is this for home use, a vehicle go-bag, or both?
questions.description: The intended use case changes the portability and packaging requirements significantly.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline for when this should be fully assembled?
questions.description: A target completion date helps structure a realistic shopping and assembly timeline.
